item.title: Prime Minister Kim Min-seok meets with election winners and continues visits to Honam region… whispers of "keeping party convention in mind" (김민석 총리, 당선자 만나고 호남 방문 이어가…“전당대회 염두” 뒷말)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok has been meeting with winners of the June 3 local elections and making multiple visits to the Honam region in recent days. Within the party, there are murmurs about his movements, suggesting he appears to be preparing for the party convention while serving as the sitting prime minister. (김민석 국무총리가 연일 6·3 지방선거 당선자들을 만나거나 호남 지역을 여러 차례 방문하고 있다. 당 일각에서는 현직 총리 신분으로 전당대회를 준비하는 듯한 행보에 대해 뒷말이 나온다.)

On the 19th, Prime Minister Kim visited the Saemangeum area in Gunsan, North Jeolla Province, where he held an on-site meeting with local university students. Along with Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Kim Yoon-deok, Saemangeum Development Agency Commissioner Moon Seong-yo, and Hyundai Motor Vice President Shin Seung-gyu, he explained investment plans for Saemangeum and the government's support initiatives, listening to young people's opinions on regional development directions. Since the end of the June 3 local elections, Kim has focused his schedule on the Honam region, attending the '2026 New Honam Forum' hosted by KBC in Gwangju's Seo-gu on the 6th, a meeting of related agencies for the launch of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City in Naju, South Jeolla, on the 16th, and a policy meeting with the offshore wind power industry in Yeosu, South Jeolla, on the 17th. (김 총리는 19일 전북 군산 새만금을 찾아 지역 대학생들과 현장 간담회를 진행했다. 김윤덕 국토부 장관, 문성요 새만금개발청장, 신승규 현대자동차 부사장과 함께 새만금 투자 계획과 정부의 지원 계획을 설명하고 지역발전 방향에 대한 청년들 목소리를 듣는 자리였다. 김 총리는 6·3 지방선거가 끝난 직후인 지난 6일 광주 서구에서 열린 케이비시(KBC) ‘2026 뉴호남 포럼’에, 16일 전남 나주에서 열린 전남광주통합특별시 출범준비 관계기관 간담회에, 17일 전남 여수에서 열린 여수 해상풍력 산업계 정책간담회에 참석하는 등 호남 지역에 일정을 집중하는 모습이다.)

Prime Minister Kim also attended a workshop for elected officials of the Gyeonggi Province Party on the 10th-11th, a workshop for elected officials of the North Chungcheong Party on the 14th, and held a meeting with elected metropolitan government heads on the 15th. Regarding Kim's activities, Supreme Council member Moon Jung-bok pointed out during an on-site Supreme Council meeting on the 12th that "for a person responsible for acting on behalf of the nation while the president is on a foreign tour, spending two consecutive days giving congratulatory speeches and taking photos at workshops for elected officials is not an urgent task." (김 총리는 또 지난 10~11일에는 경기도당, 14일에는 충북도당 당선자 워크숍에 참석하고 15일에는 광역단체장 당선자 간담회를 진행했다. 이 같은 김 총리의 행보를 두고 문정복 최고위원은 지난 12일 현장 최고위원회의에서 “대통령 순방 중 국가를 대리하는 책임자가 연이틀이나 당선자 워크숍에서 축사하고 사진 찍은 것이 급박한 업무는 아니다”라고 지적했다.)

A two-term lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh* in a phone call, "It's hard not to see this as going to Honam for the party convention," adding, "It's inappropriate for a prime minister overseeing the government while the president is abroad." Prime Minister Kim, who has already indicated his intention to resign and is widely assumed to be running for the party convention, is expected to step down after attending the Summer Davos Forum in China from the 22nd to the 24th. (한 재선 의원은 한겨레와의 통화에서 “전당대회를 위해서 호남에 가는 것으로 보일 수밖에 없다”라며 “심지어 대통령이 순방을 가 있는 동안에 정부를 통할하는 국무총리의 일정으로는 부적절하다”라고 말했다. 이미 전당대회 출마를 기정사실로 하고 사의를 표명한 김 총리는 오는 22∼24일 중국에서 열리는 하계 다보스포럼에 참석한 뒤 직을 내려놓을 것으로 점쳐진다.)

Meanwhile, Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae is also making successive visits to the Honam region ahead of the party convention. On this day as well, he met with local elected officials in Jeonju, North Jeolla. The first on-site Supreme Council meeting after the local elections was held on the 12th at the Kim Dae-jung Convention Center in Gwangju's Seo-gu, and on the 9th, he had a private lunch with North Jeolla Governor Lee Won-taek in North Jeolla. Chung's on-site Supreme Council meeting in Gwangju and his repeated visits to Honam have also been interpreted as moves to win over public sentiment in Honam, where about 30% of the party's paid members reside, ahead of the convention. (한편 정청래 민주당 대표 역시 전당대회를 앞두고 연이어 호남을 방문하고 있다. 이날도 전북 전주에서 지역 당선자들을 만났다. 지방선거 이후 첫 현장 최고위원회의는 12일 광주 서구 김대중컨벤션센터에서 열었고, 지난 9일에는 전북에서 이원택 전북도지사와 비공개 오찬을 했다. 정 대표의 광주 현장 최고위원회의나 연이은 호남 방문을 두고도 전당대회를 앞두고 권리당원의 30%에 달하는 호남 민심을 잡으려는 행보라는 해석이 나왔다.)

Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee, Amid Falling Approval Ratings and Intensifying Ruling Party Conflict: “Don’t Fight Like Mortal Enemies” (이 대통령, 지지율 하락·여권 갈등 격화에 “원수 싸우듯 하지 마라”)
item.description:
<<>> President Lee Jae-myung on the 19th said to his ruling party, the Democratic Party of Korea, “Should we be waging war, not competing among people inside the same fence, calling it the same camp?” and added, “Don’t fight like mortal enemies.” This is interpreted as a remark addressing the escalating conflict not only among key figures of the ruling party but also within the support base, including party members, ahead of the August 17 party convention. Around the June 3 local elections, President Lee stated, “There is no change in state affairs,” and also expressed the view that the main cause of the recent decline in government and ruling party approval ratings is the internal conflict within the ruling camp. ()

President Lee made these remarks during a briefing on the results of his European tour held at the Chuncheon Hall of the Presidential Office, saying, “Should we be waging war, not competing among people inside the same fence called the same camp?” President Lee continued, “Insulting, tearing down, fabricating nonexistent facts to attack, and then claiming unfairness. Why do you do that? Making up nonexistent facts with a straw man tactic and just attacking—you might think it’s a technique, but it’s a bad thing. It’s irreparable between each other.” ( 이재명 대통령은 19일 여당인 더불어민주당을 향해 “같은 진영이라고 울타리 안에 있는 사람들끼리 경쟁하는 게 아니라 전쟁을 해서야 되겠느냐”며 “원수 싸우듯 하지 말라”고 말했다. 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 여당 주요 인사들은 물론, 당원 등 지지층 내부까지 갈등이 격화하는 상황을 두고 한 말로 해석된다. 이 대통령은 6·3 지방선거 전후로 ”국정은 변한 것이 없다”며 최근의 정부·여당 지지율 하락의 주요 원인이 여권 내 갈등이란 생각도 밝혔다. )

These remarks by President Lee appear to be his stance on the heightened conflict within the ruling party after the local elections. Recently, within the ruling party, alongside the blame on Representative Jeong Cheong-rae for the local election results, there have been ongoing demands for Representative Jeong to resign from his leadership position and not run in the party convention. In this process, public clashes within the leadership have occurred repeatedly during Supreme Council meetings, and the war of nerves between the pro-leadership faction and the non-leadership faction has intensified. A two-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area expressed concern, saying, “Even among party members, we’re seeing card news with distortions and manipulations being circulated, and it’s escalating to a level of mutual attacks.” This suggests that President Lee is indicating that the conflict within the ruling camp has reached a dangerous level. ( 이 대통령은 이날 청와대 춘추관에서 연 유럽 순방 결과 브리핑에서 “같은 진영이라고 하는 울타리 안에 있는 사람들끼리 경쟁하는 것이 아니라 전쟁을 해서야 되겠느냐”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “(상대방을) 모욕하고, 헐뜯고, 없는 사실 만들어서 공격하고, 그러니까 또 억울하다고. 왜 그렇게 하느냐”라며 “허수아비 전법이라고 없는 사실을 지어내고, 거기에 막 공격하고, 이것도 하나의 테크닉이라고 생각할지 모르지만 나쁜 짓이다. 다시 서로 회복할 수 없다”고 했다. )

President Lee also shared his view that extreme internal party conflict is the cause of the decline in approval ratings, saying, “There may be various analyses about the decline in approval ratings, but I think the biggest one is, ‘We’re struggling to make a living and dying, and what are you fighting about? What does your squabbling have to do with our lives and the public duties we entrusted to you?’” A first-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, “I believe there is a growing recognition among lawmakers that this situation should not drag on any longer.” ( 이 대통령의 이런 발언은 지방선거 뒤 여당 내 갈등이 고조된 상황에 대한 입장으로 보인다. 최근 여당에서는 지방선거 결과에 대한 정청래 대표 책임론과 함께, 정 대표를 향한 대표직 사퇴와 전당대회 불출마 요구가 이어지고 있다. 이 과정에서 최고위원회의 중 지도부 내 공개 충돌이 잇따랐고, 당권파와 비당권파 간 신경전도 고조됐다. 한 수도권 재선 의원은 “당원들끼리도 왜곡·조작까지 이뤄진 카드뉴스를 만들어서 돌리고 서로 싸우는 수준으로 가고 있다”고 우려했다. 이 대통령이 여권 내 갈등이 위험수위에 이른 것이란 지적을 내놓은 것이란 얘기다.)

On this day as well, President Lee indirectly expressed his discomfort toward Representative Jeong and figures in the pro-leadership faction. Key examples include his remarks during the briefing directed at the ruling party: “It’s hard to represent the whole by only gathering those who actively agree and sympathize,” and “A minority opposition party can survive by making strong arguments and rallying supporters, but it’s different for a majority ruling party in power.” President Lee had previously expressed similar views on the role of the ruling party in his press conference marking the first year of his term on the 8th and in a post titled “The Ruling Party, the Opposition Party, and Political Responsibility” on X (formerly Twitter) on the 13th. ( 이 대통령은 “(지지율 하락에) 여러 가지 분석이 있겠지만 제일 큰 건 ‘먹고살기 힘들어 죽겠는데 뭘 가지고 싸우는 거냐, 도대체 너네 다툼이라는 것이 우리 삶과 무슨 상관이고 우리가 맡긴 공적 업무랑 무슨 상관이냐’가 아닐까라는 제 생각”이라며 극심한 당내 갈등이 지지율 하락의 원인이란 생각도 밝혔다. 한 수도권 초선 의원은 “의원들 사이에서도 이 상황이 더 길어져선 안 된다는 인식이 퍼지고 있다고 본다”고 했다. )

The fact that President Lee cited “to eliminate the possibility of becoming a target of political attacks” as the reason for handing over discussions on the direction and method of abolishing the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority to the National Assembly is also interpreted as a remark aimed at Representative Jeong. Since taking office as party leader in August last year, Representative Jeong has maintained a hardline stance on prosecution reform and has shown differences with the government on several occasions, including during the legislative process for the Public Prosecution Office and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office. Recently, he has frequently mentioned the “complete abolition of supplementary investigation authority,” which is widely seen inside and outside the party as an intention to appeal for support from hardline party members and supporters. (이 대통령은 이날도 정 대표와 당권파 인사들을 향한 불편한 심기를 에둘러 표시했다. 브리핑 중 여당을 향해 “적극적으로 동의하고 공감하는 사람만 모아서는 전체를 대표하기 어렵다”, “소수야당은 주장을 세게 하고 지지자를 결집해야 살아남지만 최다수 집권 여당이 됐다면 다르다”고 말한 것이 대표적이다. 이 대통령은 지난 8일 취임 1년 기자회견과 13일 엑스(X)에 올린 ‘여당과 야당 그리고 정치적 책임’이란 제목의 글에서도 여당의 역할에 대해 비슷한 생각을 밝힌 바 있다.)

Seeming to keep this in mind, President Lee said, “There is an aspect that this (discussion on supplementary investigation authority) is a polluted topic. It is not without a side of being used as a political slogan,” adding, “It’s not desirable for us to get involved.” This appears to reflect the recognition that, with the party convention already being used as a material for power struggles within the party, it has become difficult for the government to lead legislative discussions. Regarding Representative Jeong’s repeated references to abolishing supplementary investigation authority, President Lee also said, “Shouldn’t individual lawmakers freely express their thoughts on supplementary investigation authority? But this shouldn’t be done in a repressive manner,” and “We’ll do as the National Assembly says. Since authority has been given, responsibility will follow too.” ( 이 대통령이 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 방향과 방식에 대한 논의를 국회에 넘긴 이유로 “정치적 공격 대상이 될 가능성을 없애기 위해서”라고 밝힌 점도 정 대표를 겨냥한 발언이란 해석이 나온다. 정 대표는 지난해 8월 대표직 취임 이후 강경한 검찰개혁 노선을 유지하며 공소청·중대범죄수사청 입법 과정 등 여러 차례 정부와 이견을 보인 바 있다. 최근 들어선 “보완수사권 완전 폐지”를 빈번히 언급하고 있는데, 이는 강성 당원·지지층을 향해 지지를 호소하기 위한 의도란 게 당 안팎의 대체적 해석이다. )

Within the Democratic Party, there are mixed observations on whether the discussion on supplementary investigation authority will emerge as a point of contention in the party convention. A two-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, “Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a potential competitor of Representative Jeong, is also in favor of abolishing supplementary investigation authority, so there’s no disagreement and it won’t become an issue.” A multi-term lawmaker said, “It’s not that there’s actually a policy debate, but rather there are people who want to make it an issue.” ( 이 대통령은 이런 점을 염두에 둔 듯 “이게(보완수사권 논의가) 오염된 주제라는 측면이 있다. 정치적 슬로건으로 활용되는 측면이 없지 않다”며 “우리가 끼는 게 바람직하지 않다”고 했다. 이미 전당대회가 당권 싸움의 소재로서 활용되기 시작한 상황에서 정부가 입법 논의를 주도하긴 어려워졌단 인식으로 보인다. 이 대통령은 정 대표가 보완수사권 폐지를 거듭 언급하고 있는 것에 대해선 “개별 국회의원이 (보완수사권에 대해) 어떤 생각을 하는지는 자유롭게 표명해야 하지 않겠나. 그런데 이게 억압의 방식이어선 안 된다”, “국회가 하자는 대로 하겠다. 권한을 줬으니 책임도 지겠죠” 등의 말도 남겼다. )

Representative Jeong said at the Supreme Council meeting that day, “I will ensure that the flag of prosecution reform is not torn,” and Lee Seong-yoon, a Supreme Council member close to Representative Jeong, repeatedly highlighted this stance, saying, “There were reports that the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act regarding supplementary investigation authority could be delayed until after the party convention. The government denied it, but it’s making the hearts of citizens, who are frustrated that prosecution reform isn’t proceeding properly, even more anxious.” ( 민주당 내에선 보완수사권 논의가 전당대회 쟁점으로 떠오를지를 두고 엇갈린 관측이 나오고 있다. 한 수도권 재선 의원은 “(정 대표의 잠재 경쟁자인) 김민석 총리도 보완수사권 폐지 입장이라 이견이 없어 쟁점이 될 일도 없다”고 했다. 한 다선 의원은 “실제 정책적으로 쟁점이 있다기보다 쟁점화하고 싶은 사람이 있는 것”이라고 말했다. )

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 정 대표는 이날 최고위원회의에서 “검찰개혁이 깃발이 찢어지지 않도록 하겠다”고 말했고, 정 대표와 가까운 이성윤 최고위원은 “보완수사권 관련 형사소송법 개정이 전당대회 이후로 미뤄질 수 있다는 보도가 있었다. 정부는 부인했지만 검찰개혁이 제대로 안 될까 봐 답답해하는 국민 가슴을 더 답답하게 만들고 있는 상황”이라며 거듭 이런 기조를 부각했다. )

item.title: Chung Dong-young: "We Must Enter the Gateway to Freezing North Korea's Nuclear Program... 'North Korea is an Enemy' Expression Should Be Discussed at the NSC" (정동영 “북핵 동결 입구로 들어가야…‘북한은 적’ 표현 NSC서 논의를”)
item.description:
<<>> Unification Minister Chung Dong-young stated regarding the North Korean nuclear issue, "As President Lee Jae-myung said, a 'halt' is urgent. We must enter the gateway to freezing the program." ()

Minister Chung met with reporters on the 19th before the '25th Peaceful Unification Democratic Education Committee Inauguration Ceremony' held at the National Institute for Peaceful Unification Democratic Education in Gangbuk-gu, Seoul, and noted, "When it comes to denuclearization, between reality and goals, the more important thing now is reality. If shouting slogans for denuclearization would work, I'd shout them every day." He repeatedly emphasized the importance of a realistic understanding and step-by-step solution proposed by President Lee. ( 정동영 통일부 장관은 북핵 문제에 대해 “이재명 대통령이 말한 대로 ‘중단'이 시급하다. 동결 입구로 들어가야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee, during a briefing at the Cheongwadae Chun Chu-gwan on the results of his European tour and attendance at the G7 summit, mentioned that he had told then-U.S. President Donald Trump that it was time to negotiate with North Korea over stopping additional production of nuclear materials and further development of missiles, and called for realistic proposals that North Korea could agree to. ( 정 장관은 19일 서울 강북구 국립평화통일민주교육원에서 열린 ‘제25기 평화통일교육위원 출범식'에 앞서 취재진과 만나 “비핵화는 이제 현실과 목표 중 더 중요한 것은 현실”이라며 이렇게 밝혔다. 그는 “비핵화 구호를 외쳐서 될 것 같으면 매일 외친다”며 이 대통령이 제시한 현실적 인식과 단계적 해법의 중요성을 거듭 강조했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the maintenance or revision of the phrase 'the North Korean regime and its military are our enemy' currently included in the Defense White Paper, Minister Chung said, "It should be discussed at the NSC (National Security Council)." While avoiding a direct answer on whether this phrase, included in the Defense White Paper published under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, should be revised, he added, "The Lee Jae-myung administration is a successor to a democratic administration, not a successor to the hostile and confrontational policies of the Yoon Suk-yeol administration." ( 이 대통령은 이날 청와대 춘추관에서 연 유럽 순방과 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석 결과 브리핑에서 당시 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령에게 핵물질 추가 생산 및 미사일 추가 개발 중단을 놓고 북한과 협상할 때라고 말했으며, 북한이 공감할 만한 현실적인 제안을 할 것을 요청했다고 소개했다.)

Earlier, a Defense Ministry official denied media reports that the phrase 'the North Korean regime is our enemy' could be removed from the Defense White Paper to be published at the end of the year, stating, "There is no change in the position that the North Korean regime and its military are our enemies," presenting a different opinion. ( 한편, 정 장관은 현재 국방백서에 기재된 ‘북한 정권과 북한군의 우리의 적’이라는 표현의 유지 또는 수정에 대해 “엔에스시(NSC·국가안전보장회의)에서 논의해야 한다”고 말했다. 그는 윤석열 정부 때 발간된 국방백서에 실린 해당 표현이 수정돼야 하는지에 대해 즉답을 피하면서도 “이재명 정부는 민주 정부의 계승 정부이지 윤석열 정부의 적대·대결정책의 계승 정부가 아니다”라고 말했다.)

The 25th Peaceful Unification Democratic Education Committee Inauguration Ceremony was attended by Minister Chung, Seoul Metropolitan Superintendent of Education Jung Keun-sik, Bang Yong-seung, Secretary General of the Peaceful Unification Democratic Advisory Council, and approximately 250 newly appointed members of the committee. ( 앞서 국방부 당국자는 연말 발간될 국방백서에서 ‘북한 정권은 우리의 적’ 표현이 삭제될 수 있다는 언론 보도에 대해 사실이 아니라며 “북한 정권과 북한군이 우리의 적이라는 입장에 변함이 없다”고 전날 밝혔는데, 이와 다른 의견을 내놓은 것이다.)

In his opening address, Minister Chung explained the goal of providing at least one hour of 'peace, unification, and democratic education' per year to elementary, middle, and high school students, and outlined plans to expand the number of Peaceful Unification Democratic Education Committee members from the current 4,000 to a total of 10,000 by the end of the year. Additionally, he said he would request the Ministry of Education to restore the song 'Our Wish,' symbolizing the aspiration for unification and omitted from textbooks in the late 2000s, back into school curricula. ( 이날 제25기 평화통일민주교육위원 출범식에는 정 장관 외에도 정근식 서울특별시 교육감, 방용승 민주평화통일자문회의사무처 사무처장을 비롯해 새로 위촉된 평화통일민주교육위원 250여명이 참석했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr ( 정 장관은 이날 개회사를 통해 초중고교 학생들에게 1년에 최소 1시간은 ‘평화·통일·민주교육’을 하자는 목표로 현재 4천여명인 평화통일민주교육위원을 연말까지 총 1만여 명으로 확대할 계획이라고 설명했다. 이와 함께 2000년대 후반 교과서에서 빠진 통일 염원을 상징하는 노래 ‘우리의 소원’을 교과서에 복원해 달라고 교육부에 요청하겠다고 말했다.)

item.title: 1,398 Polling Stations Nationwide Had Less Than 50% of Main Ballot Papers (전국 투표소 1398곳, 본투표 용지 50%도 안 갖고 있었다)
item.description:
On June 3, the day of the local elections, it was confirmed on the 19th that 1,398 polling stations across the country had been supplied with ballot papers amounting to less than 50% of the number of eligible voters. (6·3 지방선거 당일, 선거인 수의 50%도 되지 않는 용지를 배부받은 투표구(투표소)가 전국에 1398곳이나 되는 것으로 19일 확인됐다.)

According to data on "ballot paper distribution quantities by polling station" obtained by People Power Party lawmaker Park Jun-tae through the National Election Commission (NEC), there were 1,398 polling stations nationwide where the percentage of main ballot papers prepared relative to the number of eligible voters was less than 50%. In particular, the 7th polling station in Bulro-daegok-dong, Seo-gu, Incheon, had 3,543 eligible voters but only 700 ballot papers distributed to the station—less than 20% of the voter count. Similarly, the 2nd polling station in Haenam-eup, Haenam-gun, Jeollanam-do, had 2,782 eligible voters but received only 700 ballot papers, about 25%. A total of six polling stations in areas such as Suncheon, Jeollanam-do; Jongno-gu, Seoul; and Iksan, Jeonbuk, prepared ballot papers amounting to less than 40% of eligible voters. The 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, where voting was suspended on election day due to a shortage of ballot papers, had a main ballot paper preparation rate of only 49.27%. (박준태 국민의힘 의원이 중앙선거관리위원회를 통해 확보한 ‘투표구별 투표용지 배부 수량’ 자료를 보면, 투표구별 선거인 수 대비 본투표 준비용지의 백분율이 50% 미만인 투표구는 전국 1398곳이었다. 특히 인천 서구 불로대곡동 제7투표구는 선거인 수가 3543명이었지만 투표구에 배부된 투표용지는 700장뿐이었다. 선거인의 20%도 채 되지 않는 숫자다. 전남 해남 해남읍제2투표구도 선거인이 2782명인데 약 25%인 700장만 배부받았다. 전남 순천, 서울 종로, 전북 익산 등에서 총 6곳 투표구가 선거인 수 40%가 되지 않는 투표용지를 준비했다. 본투표 당일 용지 부족으로 투표 중단 사태가 발생한 서울 송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소의 경우 본투표 준비용지 백분율이 49.27%였다.)

On December 10 of last year, the NEC amended the comprehensive management guidelines for the 9th nationwide simultaneous local elections with the approval of the Secretary-General. The guidelines state: "If the need for reduced printing is recognized, considering the expected advance voting rate and voter turnout in recent elections, the number of ballot papers printed for election day may be adjusted by committee resolution to be based on a minimum of 50% of eligible voters." Accordingly, ballot papers should have been prepared within a range of 50% to 100% of eligible voters following a vote by the city, county, or district election committee, but the lower-bound guideline proved ineffective. (중앙선관위는 지난해 12월10일 사무총장 전결로 제9회 전국동시지방선거 종합관리지침을 개정했다. 해당 지침에는 “선거일 투표용지 인쇄매수는 예상 사전투표율 및 최근 선거의 투표율 등을 감안하여 축소인쇄 필요성이 인정되는 경우 위원회 의결로 선거인수 50%(하한)를 기준으로 조정 가능하다”고 돼 있다. 이에 따라 시·군·구 선관위원회 의결을 거쳐 선거인 수의 50~100% 범위 내로 투표용지를 준비해야 했지만, 하한 기준 지침은 유명무실했던 셈이다.)

Cho Hyun-wook, chair of the NEC's fact-finding committee on the ballot paper shortage, held a briefing at the Government Complex in Gwacheon on the morning of the 19th and stated, "There is a need to raise the ballot paper printing ratio to 70% or more to ensure the voting rights of citizens are fully guaranteed." (조현욱 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명위원장은 이날 오전 정부과천청사에서 브리핑을 열어 “유권자 참정권을 확실하게 보장하도록 투표용지 인쇄 비율을 70% 이상으로 상향할 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: China 'Responds' to Reaffirmation of 'One China'... Will a Breakthrough in Korea-China Relations Open? (‘하나의 중국’ 재확인에 중국 ‘화답’…한중관계 돌파구 열릴까)
item.description:
After a South Korean Foreign Ministry official reaffirmed the position of respecting the 'One China' principle, China's Foreign Ministry promptly issued a statement evaluating this positively. Attention is focused on subtle signals as to whether a breakthrough might open in the strained Korea-China relations, which have remained chilly despite two summits following the inauguration of the Lee Jae-myung administration. (한국 외교부 당국자가 ‘하나의 중국’을 존중한다는 입장을 재확인하자, 중국 외교부가 이를 긍정적으로 평가한다는 입장을 곧바로 내놨다. 이재명 정부 출범 뒤 두차례 정상회담에도 불구하고 냉랭해진 한중관계의 돌파구가 열릴지, 미묘한 신호가 주목된다.)

Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian posted a statement on the ministry's website around midnight (local time) on the 19th, stating, "This time, the director general in charge of South Korea's Foreign Ministry fully and publicly reaffirmed to the media the references to Taiwan in the Korea-China joint communiqué on diplomatic relations, and China evaluates this positively." He added, "We hope and believe that South Korea will firmly uphold the original spirit of diplomatic relations, comply with political commitments, and practice the 'One China' principle through concrete actions to safeguard the political foundation of Korea-China relations." ( 중국 외교부 린젠 대변인은 19일 자정(현지시각)께 외교부 누리집에 입장문을 올려 “이번에 한국 외교부 담당 국장이 언론에 완전하고 공개적으로 중한 수교 공동성명의 대만 관련 언급을 재확인했는데, 중국은 이에 대해 긍정적으로 평가한다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “우리는 한국이 수교 초심을 굳게 지키고, 정치적 약속을 준수하며, 실제 행동으로 ‘하나의 중국' 원칙을 실천해 중한관계의 정치적 기초를 수호하기를 희망하고, 그럴 것이라 믿는다”고 덧붙였다.)

The previous day, Nam Jin, Director General of the Northeast Central Asia Bureau at South Korea's Foreign Ministry, explained the results of the Korea-China director-level consultations held in Seoul on the 17th to reporters, reaffirming the position of respecting the 'One China' principle, to which China's Foreign Ministry immediately responded. In these consultations, China's Director General of the Asian Affairs Department, Liu Jinsong, raised the Taiwan issue, while the South Korean side reiterated the stance stated in the 1992 Korea-China joint communiqué: "The government of the Republic of Korea recognizes the government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legitimate government of China, and respects China's position that there is only one China and that Taiwan is a part of China." They added, "This position has remained unchanged across successive administrations." <<> This appears to be a move by the South Korean government to reinforce momentum in Korea-China relations by reaffirming existing principles, in response to China's backlash over South Korea's recent removal of the 'China (Taiwan)' notation from electronic entry declarations and China's demand for a stance on the Taiwan issue. Although two summits—held in November of last year and January of this year—after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration agreed on a full restoration of Korea-China relations, China has been delaying progress recently. This is due to accumulated grievances from China over: △ South Korea's change in the Taiwan notation on electronic entry declarations; △ South Korea strengthening ties with Japan amid China-Japan tensions; and △ the reinforcement of South Korea-U.S. and South Korea-U.S.-Japan cooperation. Spokesperson Lin Jian, in a regular briefing on the 18th, expressed "grave concern" over the U.S. holding consecutive Extended Deterrence Dialogue (EDD) with Japan and a Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG) meeting with South Korea, stating, "We hope South Korea will act prudently and contribute more to regional stability." <<> At the very least, the fact that Director General Liu Jinsong of China's Asian Affairs Department visited South Korea after seven months to hold talks with South Korean diplomatic officials and discuss Korea-China relations and the situation on the Korean Peninsula can be seen as a subtle 'signal of thawing.' <<> However, the key question is how to resolve fundamental issues, such as the spread of signals that China has tacitly accepted North Korea's nuclear armament and China's strong wariness of South Korea-U.S.-Japan cooperation. While communication on Korean Peninsula issues also took place during the Korea-China director-level consultations, Spokesperson Lin Jian mentioned only the Taiwan issue, which China is sensitive about, omitting the Korean Peninsula issue. <<> It has been reported that South Korea conveyed to China during the consultations that the spread of the 'tacit approval of North Korea's nuclear program' theory is undesirable and does not contribute to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. Previously, following the summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in Pyongyang on the 8th, the term 'denuclearization' completely disappeared from the joint statements of both countries, leading to widespread observations that China has changed its policy to tacitly accept North Korea's nuclear armament. <<> A key signal for the thawing of Korea-China relations is expected to be when Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi will visit South Korea, as agreed upon during the January summit. The director-level consultations did not finalize a schedule for his visit. <<> Yang Gap-yong, a senior research fellow at the Institute for National Security Strategy, assessed, "While China's diplomacy is actively advancing in many areas, the lack of significant progress with South Korea makes it encouraging that China's Director General of Asian Affairs visited South Korea and sat down at the negotiation table." He added, "With opportunities for Korea-China summit exchanges at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in November and a possible encounter at the UN General Assembly in September, efforts should be doubled to meticulously outline what can be given and taken, as well as what should not be conceded, in Korea-China relations, aiming to reset the relationship based on reciprocity and achieve substantive diplomatic outcomes." <<> Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter: minggu@hani.co.kr ( 전날 외교부 남진 동북중앙아시아국 국장은 지난 17일 서울에서 열린 한중 국장급 협의 결과를 기자들에게 설명하면서 ‘하나의 중국’ 존중 입장을 재확인했는데, 이에 중국 외교부가 곧바로 화답한 것이다. 이 협의에서 중국 외교부의 류진쑹 아주국장은 대만 문제를 거론했고, 우리 쪽은 1992년 한중 수교 공동성명에서 밝힌 “대한민국 정부는 중화인민공화국 정부를 중국의 유일 합법 정부로 승인하며, 오직 하나의 중국만이 있고 대만은 중국의 일부분이라는 중국의 입장을 존중한다”는 입장을 다시 확인하면서 “역대 정부에 걸쳐 이러한 입장에는 변함이 없다”고 밝혔다. )
